verdict.rationale: dltHub offers a personal Playground workspace where a sample pipeline runs and a coding agent is launched. dlt also ships a local DuckDB destination and lets you switch destinations without changing pipeline code, so agents can test locally before loading to production. None of these is explicitly documented as an isolated sandbox that guarantees production data stays untouched, and the read-only SQL MCP tool is a query safeguard, not sandbox isolation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the Playground as isolated from production data, documented dev/prod environment separation, hands-on or independent corroboration of sandboxed testing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: runs a sample pipeline in your personal Playground workspace, and launches your coding agent ready to build your own source
This approach is especially useful when switching between destinations without modifying the actual pipeline code.
